# Daily Active Users (DAU) Analysis

This report analyzes the Daily Active Users (DAU) over time and includes a trend line.

```{r}
# Load ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

# Load the data
DAU <- read.csv("DAU.csv")

# Convert date column to Date format
DAU$date <- as.Date(DAU$date)

# Plot DAU with a trend line
ggplot(DAU, aes(x = date, y = DAU)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "red", size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "green", linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Daily Active Users (DAU) Over Time",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Daily Active Users") +
  theme_minimal()
```
